# third_party/

Header-only libraries used **only by the server**, never by `core/`.

| File | Library | License | Get it from |
|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `httplib.h` | cpp-httplib | MIT | github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib (single header) |
| `json.hpp` | nlohmann/json | MIT | github.com/nlohmann/json (single-include release) |

Download a tagged release (not the latest commit), commit the header here, and note the version in this README.

Confirm with the instructor that these are allowed before relying on them.
